title: New Moon Bar & Grill
venue_description:
Montgomery's Premier Late-Night Bar & Grill

New Moon Bar & Grill has established itself as one of Montgomery's most beloved late-night destinations offering a unique combination of exceptional food quality music and welcoming atmosphere. Open from 11:00 AM until 1:00 AM the venue serves as both a family-friendly restaurant and an energetic nightlife spot.

Culinary Excellence

The menu features handcrafted burgers with thick juicy patties and perfectly toasted buns. The chicken wings are a signature dish with crispy exteriors juicy interiors and varying heat levels to satisfy every palate. The Moon Burger has become legendary among locals drawing praise for its flavor-stacked composition. The kitchen stays open late making it Montgomery's go-to spot for quality midnight meals.

Music and Entertainment

New Moon hosts weekly open mic nights every Thursday at 8:00 PM providing a platform for local musicians to perform. The venue features live DJs who create an energetic atmosphere perfect for both dining and socializing. Musicians frequently cool off at New Moon after performances at other venues making it a hub for the local music community.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The venue attracts an eclectic mix of guests from college students and young professionals to families and music lovers. The atmosphere balances family-friendly accessibility with genuine bar-and-grill authenticity. Wrapped in neon lights and good energy the space offers everything from baby seats to beer flights creating an inclusive environment where different crowds coexist comfortably.

Service and Hours

Known for attentive staff and fast service New Moon maintains high standards throughout their extended hours. The drink selection includes craft cocktails tropical options and traditional beer while the full bar caters to diverse preferences. With a health score of 92 out of 100 the venue maintains strong food safety standards.

Community Impact

New Moon has become an integral part of Montgomery's social fabric serving as an unofficial gathering place for locals. The venue's ability to stay open late while maintaining food quality and atmosphere makes it unique in the area. Whether guests seek live music great food or a welcoming late-night environment New Moon delivers consistently.

title: 1048 Jazz & Blues
venue_description:
Montgomery's Premier Jazz and Blues Venue

1048 Jazz & Blues has been a cornerstone of Montgomery's live music scene for over 15 years operating as a dive bar with serious musical credentials. Located in the Old Cloverdale neighborhood this intimate venue offers live music 365 days a year making it a rare find in the Southeast.

Venue Character and Atmosphere

Housed in a converted old house at 1104 E Fairview Ave the venue maintains its quirky charm with mismatched architecture and a neighborhood feel. The space features both indoor and outdoor areas with a pool available for patrons. Despite its worn appearance and dive bar aesthetic the venue has earned a devoted following for its authentic atmosphere and no-frills approach to live music.

Music Programming

The venue specializes in jazz and blues performances with live music every single night of the year. Sunday nights around 10:00 PM feature some of the finest jazz performances in the region. The intimate setting creates an open mic atmosphere where talented musicians gather to perform impromptu sessions. Keyboard players pianists and full bands grace the small stage creating memorable musical experiences.

Pricing and Accessibility

Cover charges typically run around five dollars making live music accessible to all. Drinks are reasonably priced with beer and wine available. The venue opens at 4:00 PM daily and operates until 2:00 AM most nights creating a late-night destination for music lovers. Service is known to be fast despite the casual setting.

Community and Culture

1048 Jazz & Blues serves as a gathering place for locals and music enthusiasts. The friendly easygoing crowd creates a welcoming environment where strangers become friends over shared appreciation for live music. The venue's longevity and consistency have made it a must-visit destination for anyone seeking authentic live jazz and blues in Montgomery.

Historical Notes

The bar name 1048 originates from its previous location though it now operates from 1104 E Fairview Ave. The venue has maintained its original name as a nod to its history and loyal customer base who have followed it through the years.

title: Jerry's Juke Joint
venue_description:
Montgomery's Historic Music Venue

Jerry's Juke Joint stands as one of Montgomery's premier live music venues combining rich historical significance with contemporary entertainment. Located in the Lower Commerce Street Historical District the building dates to 1920 and is listed on the National Registry of Historical Places.

Historical Architecture and Design

The venue showcases exposed brick walls towering steel beams and expansive windows that flood the space with natural light. The second-floor balcony features reclaimed bead board walls perfect for people-watching and enjoying the vibrant atmosphere. Unique historical elements include reclaimed wood from the stable of 1945 Kentucky Derby winner HOOP JR. repurposed into the mezzanine flooring and bar tops. Vintage signs from Montgomery's Greyhound Bus Station and Cunningham the Tailor's shop adorn the walls alongside other vintage advertising memorabilia. A historical Otis hand-operated freight elevator located on the balcony level under a stunning brass chandelier serves as a popular photo spot.

Musical Programming

Jerry's Juke Joint offers an eclectic mix of musical genres including country blues jazz soul and Southern rock. The stage hosts local up-and-comers as well as renowned regional and national artists. The venue operates with a Nashville Music Row-inspired approach offering all genres of music while maintaining a mission to provide a fun fellowship space for live music appreciation. Wednesday nights feature Karaoke from 6:30 PM to 9:30 PM providing an interactive musical experience for guests.

Venue Services and Amenities

The full-service bar offers traditional beer options alongside a complete array of spirits and specialty craft cocktails. Guests can bring their own food or order from local restaurants via Door Dash or Grubhub. The venue plans to host a rotating lineup of local food trucks outside the front door. With a capacity of 120 people and catering available Jerry's Juke Joint accommodates private events including holiday parties office gatherings engagement parties bachelor parties anniversaries birthdays and fundraising events.

Operating Hours and Contact

The venue operates Tuesday through Saturday opening at 5:00 PM. General Manager Hunter Sharpton oversees operations and can be reached for booking inquiries. Musicians seeking to perform can submit artist booking requests through the venue's website.

Community Impact

Jerry's Juke Joint has become an essential part of Montgomery's downtown cultural landscape. The venue provides a platform for both established and emerging artists while offering locals and tourists an authentic taste of Montgomery's musical heritage. The combination of historical significance architectural charm and diverse musical programming creates an unforgettable experience that celebrates Montgomery's past while supporting its vibrant present-day music scene.

title: Red Bluff Bar at the Silos
venue_description:
Montgomery's Riverfront Music Destination

Red Bluff Bar at the Silos represents Montgomery's newest addition to the live music scene having opened in Summer 2022 as part of the Vintage Hospitality Group. Located on the historic Alabama River waterfront in Riverfront Park this venue has quickly become the city's favorite gathering place for live music drinks food and community celebration.

Historical Significance

Before becoming Red Bluff Bar the location served as the Silos Depot a train station operated by AmTrak from 1989 to 1995. The venue name honors Montgomery's historic marker High Red Bluff also called Hostile Bluff or Thirteen Mile Bluff. This area served as a catalyst for transportation and commerce including the arrival of the first steamboat the Harriet in 1821 and the first railroad in 1880. A tunnel system built in 1879 under the railroad tracks assisted horse-drawn wagons transporting cotton. The venue continues this legacy as a common space for the entire city to gather and celebrate.

Musical Programming

Red Bluff features progressive blues funk rock jazz country R&B bluegrass hip-hop and folk music nightly on the Red Bluff Stage. The venue hosts national touring bands alongside local and regional favorites making it Montgomery's premier spot for staying connected to the local music scene. The annual Red Bluff Music Arts & Food Festival held each May at the Riverwalk Amphitheater showcases top-tier artists influenced by blues country jam jazz and soulful Southern sounds while spotlighting local and regional bands visual artists and culinary talent.

Venue Amenities and Atmosphere

Open Wednesday through Sunday Red Bluff Bar offers a rotating draft selection wine and cocktails for adults in a family and pet-friendly environment. Games including ping-pong horseshoes and cornhole are available on a first-come first-serve basis. The venue features a large walking area for dogs and outdoor seating with scenic riverfront views. The space serves as an ideal spot to enjoy local entertainment including concerts ballets Fourth of July fireworks and Montgomery Biscuits baseball games.

Operating Information

The venue closes for winter months reopening March 12 2026. Regular hours include Wednesday-Thursday 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM Friday 4:00 PM to midnight Saturday 1:00 PM to midnight and Sunday 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Monday and Tuesday the venue remains closed. The health score stands at 96 out of 100.

Community Role

Red Bluff Bar has evolved into a lively communal hub where Montgomery residents and visitors celebrate the city's greatness. The venue's mission centers on enhancing cultural opportunities for River Region citizens and uniting the community through shared love of music food and arts. The combination of historic location scenic waterfront setting diverse musical programming and inclusive atmosphere makes Red Bluff a cornerstone of Montgomery's modern entertainment landscape.
